findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hardcoded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing sensitive credentials to anyone with read access to the Terraform code or Lambda console/API, and they are stored unencrypted at rest.

The Lambda function does not specify a KMS key (kms_key_arn) for encrypting environment variables, leaving sensitive data such as embedded secrets protected only by default AWS-managed keys instead of a customer-managed key with tighter access control.
